questions.q: Why do organizations typically need centralized access management across AWS, not just within a single AWS account?
options: Because they run multiple AWS accounts (prod, dev, security, etc.) for isolation, and managing separate IAM users in each doesn't scale
Because AWS does not allow more than one IAM user per account
Because every AWS account automatically shares the same users by default
Because AWS Organizations only supports a single account
questions.explain: Multiple isolated AWS accounts are the norm, and managing separate IAM users per account creates sprawl and offboarding risk.

questions.q: What is AWS IAM Identity Center?
options: AWS's centralized hub (formerly AWS SSO) for workforce access across every account in an AWS Organization
A firewall service for AWS VPCs
A tool exclusively for root account password resets
A billing consolidation tool with no identity function
questions.explain: Identity Center lets a user sign in once and access every AWS account and role they've been granted.

questions.q: What does a "permission set" in IAM Identity Center do?
options: Defines a named collection of IAM permissions assigned to a user or group for a specific AWS account
Replaces the need for AWS accounts entirely
Controls DNS routing for an AWS VPC
Sets the AWS region a user can sign in from
questions.explain: Permission sets are how Identity Center grants specific IAM permissions to a user or group for a given account.

questions.q: How can AWS IAM Identity Center connect to an external identity provider like Entra ID?
options: Via SAML 2.0 federation, trusting sign-ins verified by that external provider
By importing the on-prem AD database directly into AWS
It cannot connect to any identity provider outside AWS
Only through a direct VPN tunnel to Azure
questions.explain: Identity Center federates to external identity providers over SAML 2.0, often paired with SCIM provisioning.

questions.q: What identity problem does federating IAM Identity Center to the same Entra ID tenant solve for a hybrid/multi-cloud organization?
options: It avoids creating a third, disconnected identity silo — the same account and lifecycle now governs on-prem, Azure, and AWS access
It eliminates the need for Entra Connect
It makes AWS the new source of truth for on-prem Active Directory
It removes the need for any AWS IAM permissions at all
questions.explain: Bridging AWS to the same Entra ID tenant means one identity, created once, governs access everywhere instead of three separate silos.
